name: raycast-bluetooth-devices
title: Bluetooth Devices
description: Manage Windows Bluetooth devices: connect, disconnect, pair, unpair, and toggle the adapter.
author: athndev

commands.name: manage-devices
commands.title: Manage Bluetooth Devices
commands.description: View, connect, disconnect, and remove paired Bluetooth devices.

commands.name: toggle-bluetooth
commands.title: Toggle Bluetooth
commands.description: Turn the Bluetooth adapter on or off instantly.

commands.name: scan-devices
commands.title: Scan for Bluetooth Devices
commands.description: Discover and pair nearby Bluetooth devices.

scripts.prebuild: node generate-icon.js && "C:\Program Files\dotnet\dotnet.exe" publish WinBluetoothCli.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o ./assets/cli
